label: Etsy Reviews Scraper
title: Etsy Reviews Scraper: Listings & Buyer Reviews to CSV
metaDescription: Scrape Etsy listing data and buyer reviews from any listing URL: price, shop, variations, shipping, ratings and review text. Export JSON or CSV.
intro: Paste Etsy listing links and get each product's full listing record (price, shop, variations, shipping, policies, ratings) plus, if you switch it on, every buyer review with its star rating, text, photos and date. Public data, no Etsy login.
useCases: See what buyers praise or complain about in a niche before you launch a product
Monitor reviews on competing listings and on your own shop
Feed review text into sentiment analysis or product research

faq.q: Does Etsy have an API for reviews?
faq.a: Etsy's Open API v3 needs a registered app and an API key. This actor needs no key: you give it public listing URLs and get the listing and its reviews back as data.
